items.b: DE BEERS TAKES 100% OF GAHCHO KUE, CANADA'S LAST MINE
items.t: Mountain Province's release gives no cash consideration: its 49% goes in satisfaction of reclamation costs and every debt owed to De Beers. An option to buy back runs to 31 December 2029.

items.b: CHOW SANG SANG'S GOLD FALLS TO 1,249 YUAN, FOOTFALL DOUBLES
items.t: Chow Tai Fook reads 1,255 yuan a gram and Lao Miao 1,252, each more than 10% under the 25 August high, on 21jingji's figures. Showroom gold in Zhengzhou quoted 934 yuan.

items.b: PLATINUM SHEDS $34 TO $1,691 ON THE 2 OCTOBER CLOSE
items.t: Gold closed $4,139.80, silver $60.274 and palladium $1,152.00 on the same mark, all four lower. Kitco's own board puts the session changes smaller, measured against Thursday's close.

items.b: META'S MUSE RUNS FREE, THEN $20 TO $100 A MONTH
items.t: The agent connects Shopify, Stripe, QuickBooks, Canva and Zoom to a retailer's Facebook and Instagram accounts. Amazon has asked to be removed, Retail Dive reports.

items.b: RAPI'S SIZES RISE BETWEEN 0.33% AND 3.00% IN A MONTH
items.t: The window runs 2 September to 2 October on Rapaport's own daily series. Gahcho Kue realised 44.4% less a carat in its latest published quarter, a rough price the polished index does not carry.
